title: Wechselpräpositionen
summary: Nine spatial prepositions (*in, an, auf, neben, hinter, über, unter, vor, zwischen*) take the **Akkusativ** when describing directed motion (**Wohin?**) and the **Dativ** when describing a static location (**Wo?**).
explanation: The preposition itself does not have a single fixed case; instead, the case communicates whether something is crossing into a new position (Akkusativ) or already resting at a location (Dativ).

rows: Ich lege das Buch **auf den** Tisch.

rules: Ask **Wohin?** (Where to?) → active movement or placement → **Akkusativ** (*der → den, die → die, das → das*).
Ask **Wo?** (Where?) → stationary location → **Dativ** (*der → **dem**, die → **der**, das → **dem**, plural → **den + -n***).
Common contractions: **in + das = ins**, **in + dem = im**, **an + das = ans**, **an + dem = am**.

examples.de: Sie stellt die Tasse **auf den** Tisch. Jetzt steht die Tasse **auf dem** Tisch.
examples.en: She puts the cup on the table. Now the cup is standing on the table.

commonMistakes.explanation: Being at a place answers 'Wo?' (static location), which requires the Dativ case (in dem = im).

exercises.hint: Feminine 'die' becomes 'der' in the Dativ case.

exercises.prompt: Ich hänge das Bild an ___ (die) Wand. (Wohin?)
exercises.hint: Feminine 'die' stays 'die' in the Akkusativ case.

note: Learn the four verb pairs together: **legen / liegen** (lay / lie), **stellen / stehen** (place upright / stand), **setzen / sitzen** (seat / sit), and **hängen / hängen**.
